svg.text: Topedal OPP Solenoid, Neopixel & Switches Board, Rev 1.1 (12 Jun 2026), as used — with pin map. All 3 boards (DP-28A to DP-28C) are identical hardware.

Same net name = same net. Yellow flag = signal net; blue flag = power/ground net. On each J100 pin: pin no. + GPIO inside the socket; LQFP48 pin / timer output / 5 V tolerance beside it (pin data per ST DS5319 Rev 20 Table 5).
Driver channel x8 (Q1–Q8; designators and net map in the driver table below)
Neopixel level shifter U2 and 5 V inputs
R25 1 kΩ + D9 green LED: +5V to GNDREF power indicator at J4

Notes: GND = solenoid voltage ground; GNDREF = 3V3 and 5V ground; Blue Pill ground and 3V3 pins are common. Rev 1.1: MOSFETs changed to IRLZ44NPbF (lower Vgs threshold). GND and GNDREF are separate nets, tied externally (P-08).
